newsitem.title: USA: Ariz. Palo Verde nuclear unit 1 at 90 pct power.
newsitem.headline: Ariz. Palo Verde nuclear unit 1 at 90 pct power.

text.p: The 1,221-megawatt (MW) Palo Verde 1 nuclear unit reached 90 percent power early Tuesday and is expected to be at full power by late Tuesday night, a spokeswoman for Arizona Public Service Co said.
The unit, which was shut for refueling September 21, was re-synchronized with the regional grid Friday and has gradually been ramping up to full power since then.
"We are doing some performance testing," the spokeswoman said. "There is a flange that we need to check, but the unit should be back to full power in less than a day."
Palo Verde's other two 1,221-MW units are operating at full output.

Arizona Power, a unit of Pinnacle West Capital Corp, is the plant's operator and 29.1-percent owner. Other owners include Edison International's Southern California Edison Co, El Paso Electric Co and Public Service Co of New Mexico.
